body_html:
Source: https://archive.org/details/gd73-02-15.sbd.hall.1580.sbeok.shnf/gd73-02-15d1t02.shn

One of my all time favs. Phil's solo in dark star... One of his best moments...Can't find a torrent or SHN ...share if you can.

Audio quality ain't great. Show dissapeared sometime in the aughts. Haven't been following archive releases.

Historically there were never great reels. The Wall of Sound had pretty much just blown up..Pigpen would pass a month later...and Feb 73 was killer.
